instruction: Change the automatic backup frequency to every 15 minutes.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save interval to 15 minutes in LibreOffice Impress via Tools > Options > Load/Save > General settings. The evaluator uses the existing check_auto_saving_time metric to verify the AutoSaveTimeIntervall value in registrymodifications.xcu matches 15 minutes. This is a paraphrased variation of the original task with a different time interval.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) which stores auto-save settings
Metric logic correctly parses XML and navigates to the right path (/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document)
Metric correctly checks the AutoSaveTimeIntervall property and compares against expected value (15 minutes)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires (auto-save frequency set to 15 minutes)
Correct parameter handling: metric accesses rules['minutes'] directly without incorrect nested access patterns
Data flow is semantically correct: vm_file getter returns file path, metric expects file path, comparison logic is sound
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to ensure LibreOffice saves settings to disk before verification (though LibreOffice typically auto-saves config changes immediately, so this is low priority)
